rationale: C25 is a direct Fort Ruger predecessor expressly incorporated into the child’s chain of modifying orders. It uses the same distinctive Hawaii ceded-land recital, restores specifically described portions of the same reservation to the Territory’s possession, use, and control, and supplies parcel descriptions that the child reuses as boundary references. This is concrete textual and administrative continuity, not merely a generic similarity between land-restoration orders. C24 is another direct Fort Ruger predecessor but is simpler and less closely aligned with the child’s possession-use-control wording. C08 has a substantial multi-parcel military-land restoration structure but concerns different reservations and lacks C25’s direct drafting continuity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: were reserved for military purposes of the United States and constitute a part of Tract No. 1 of the Fort Ruger Military Reservation, described by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 7, 1933, as modified by ... No. 10453 ... of May 18, 1953
shared_material.parent_excerpt: were reserved for military purposes by Executive Order No. 395-A of January 18, 1906, as modified by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 7, 1933 ... and by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of July 5, 1951
shared_material.explanation: Both establish the same Fort Ruger reservation history, and the child expressly identifies the May 18, 1953 order as part of the operative chain it modifies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following-described parcels of land ... comprising portions of Tract No. 1 of Fort Ruger Military Reservation, are hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described parcels of land comprising portions of the Fort Ruger Military Reservation ... are hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly identical operative restoration language applied to additional portions of the same military reservation.

shared_material.explanation: The child directly incorporates C25’s specially designated pipeline-and-roadway parcel into its new metes-and-bounds description, demonstrating material reuse of the earlier order’s legal and surveying machinery.
